newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks fall in lacklustre trade by lunch.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks fall in lacklustre trade by lunch.

text.p: Thai stocks retreated in dull trade by the lunch break on Friday due to absence of foreign investors, brokers said.
"The market was quiet. Foreign investment was thin while most local investors were also sidelined. Several regional markets closed today for Easter," said Songyos Kulvichien of Securities One.
The SET index declined 7.36 points, or 1.03 percent, to 705.25 on tiny 528 million baht half-day turnover.
Brokers said weak sentiment kept local investors on the sidelines.
They said a 140-point overnight plunge on Wall Street and setbacks of some regional markets on Friday dampened market confidence.
All key sectors lost ground by lunch. The communication sector led the decline falling 2.16 percent, and electronic components lost 2.09 percent.
Alphatec topped the active list, declining 11 baht to 112.
